series.name: Table C — Axpert MKS 1–5KVA
series.notes: Adds fault 56 + W11 (same events as V PF1, different source). No W16/W32. No BMS table in this manual.

meaning.en: Same as V PF1 fault 56 (battery open).
meaning.ur: Yeh V PF1 fault 56 jaisa hi hai (battery open).

causes.en: Wire connection or fuse burnt / battery disconnected at startup.
causes.ur: Wire connection/fuse jalana ya start par battery nikalna.

causes.en: Battery terminal corroded or clamp loose.
causes.ur: Battery terminal par zang lag gaya ya clamp dheela hai.
Lambi standby ke baad battery bilkul khaali ho gayi.

solutions.en: Check wire connection and battery polarity.
Repair or replace main board if wiring OK.
solutions.ur: Agar wiring theek ho to main board ki marammat karein ya badal dein.

source.title: Voltronic Power Axpert MKS / MKS-1-5KVA manual (official)

notes.en: Identical record shape as C2 fault 56; source differs. Platform reference entry (table source SRC-MKS15). Local brand rows may match but keep brand code space separate.
notes.ur: Yeh C2 fault 56 jaisa hi record shape hai; source alag hai. Yeh platform ka reference entry hai (table source SRC-MKS15). Local brand ki rows mil sakti hain, magar brand ka code space alag rakhein.

codes.blinkPattern: Fault icon lit; red LED solid; continuous buzzer.

meaning.en: Same as V PF1 warning W11.
meaning.ur: V PF1 warning W11 jaisa hi hai.

causes.en: Wiring/fuse fault or battery disconnected at startup.
causes.ur: Wiring/fuse ya start par battery nikalna.

solutions.en: Repair/replace main board if wiring OK.
solutions.ur: Agar wiring theek ho to main board ki marammat karein ya badal dein.

source.title: Voltronic Power Axpert MKS / MKS-1-5KVA manual (official)
